prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original tactical shooter HUD combat announcement, a transparent three-frame sprite strip for a WoW addon.
Create ONE horizontal strip with exactly THREE equal square cells in ONE row, 3:1 wide canvas, preferably 1536x512. Each cell contains the same complete specified message, fully readable.
Style family: chunky condensed STENCIL/BLOCK typography, thick dark outlines, solid angular beveled steel announcement plates with notched corners, restrained light seams, small glints or sparse particles. Bold clear hierarchy. Distinct from comic explosions and anime brush lettering: NO starbursts, NO cartoon clouds, NO fireballs, NO manga speed lines, NO ink splashes. Original designs, no game logos or character portraits, no weapons or scenery.
Animation: draw the wordmark ONCE and duplicate it across the cells. Same wording, font, letter shapes, baseline, line breaks, angle, scale and center anchor. Only plate edges, light accents, glints and particles progress: left=onset with compact accents; middle=peak with brighter edges and a strong restrained glint; right=aftershock with receding light and a few drifting particles. No flash may hide any lettering. Minor hand-drawn differences acceptable.
Readability: huge opaque high-contrast letters with clear dark separation from the plate. No tiny supporting words, no numbers, no timers, no extra text or UI widgets. Readable at only 256x256.
Layout: the ENTIRE plate, word and effects must fit inside the middle 60% width and 60% height of each square cell. Leave at least 20% EMPTY transparent border on all four sides of EACH cell. Three small isolated stickers with wide transparent gutters. Never crop tips, particles or lettering.
Genuine alpha transparency outside the plate and lettering, crisp antialiased edges, no painted checkerboard or background fill.
Specific design: GOLD clutch victory award: giant ivory and gold-faced heavy stencil letters with thick black outline over a dark steel angular rectangular plate with a shallow V-notch bottom and asymmetric GOLD side brackets. ONE centered line CLUTCH! . Controlled polished gold bevel, no elaborate badge or trophy. Onset: gold light gathers in the side brackets; peak: one strong golden four-point glint at the upper plate edge; aftershock: three small glints drift outward. Main text always fully unobscured.
Text (verbatim in EACH of the three cells, with only the specified line breaks): "CLUTCH!". Every word, hyphen and exclamation mark is mandatory.
